selection_rationale.decision_reasoning: Selected decisions/create as the minimal, safest, first refactoring pilot because it requires only a string-to-constant replacement in a single route, has no service dependencies, no business logic changes, clear scanner reduction, and enables future service refactoring without introducing risk.
selection_rationale.scope_justification: Keeping scope to exactly 1 file with 2 line changes follows STRICT EXECUTION MODE constraints: minimal, focused, low-risk change that can be easily rolled back if needed.
selection_rationale.exclusion_rationale: All other decision routes and services excluded because they require either (1) service refactoring, (2) legacy pattern migration (withCanonicalEnforcement), or (3) bug fixes (reject capability string). These are deferred to coordinated X9C-5 phase.
selection_rationale.next_steps: If decisions/create cleanup succeeds, X9E-2 can select recommendations route cleanup as secondary pilot. If successful, decision service refactoring (X9C-5) can proceed with foundation established.
